column_values.text: I just passed my real estate exam and submitted my license application.

I believe I’ll be a great fit for Culbertson and Gray because I currently work as a waiter with almost a decade of experience dealing with rejection, finding commonality in diverse crowds, and managing my time when I’m busy. I know these are all things I will need in real estate and with Culbertson and Gray’s expertise and training I believe we will be a great pair.
Currently held in SC - Charleston/Greenville/Myrtle Beach
The Firm Real Estate Company- I am the owner

Moving to the Roseville CA area in fall of 2026. I am highly motivated to break into the California market. I am a strong team player and would love an opportunity to collaborate with some of the best agents in the Sacramento area.

I would be a good fit for Culburtson and Gray Group because our core values are complementary. I’m reliable, detail-oriented, and able to communicate clearly across clients and team members—qualities I consistently bring in my work. I take ownership of my responsibilities and make sure nothing falls through the cracks, especially when managing multiple steps and timelines that require coordination and follow-through.  I’m also someone people find easy to talk to and trust. I listen carefully, communicate thoughtfully, and handle situations with a calm, steady approach, which helps build strong relationships and keeps things running smoothly. I value integrity, clear communication, and a team-oriented mindset, which I understand are important in both client interactions and a collaborative real estate environment.  As I work toward my California real estate license, I’m looking to contribute these strengths to a team while learning the transaction process in depth and growing within the industry.
